name: Ar-Raheem
short_desc: Celebrate sacred motifs with this handcrafted terracotta arched plaque depicting the Holy Kaaba and Ar-Raheem (The Most Merciful). Sealed with a protective gloss varnish and mounted with brass standoffs, it adds warmth to stone niches and display shelves.
seo_title: : Terracotta Arched Kaaba Plaque – Ar-Raheem Hand-Painted Acrylic Art with Standoff Mounts
description:
Bring warmth, history, and sacred imagery into your home with this unique arched plaque artwork. The upper section displays an artistic painterly rendering of the Holy Kaaba in black and gold, set within an arch outline, while the lower section bears the divine name Ar-Raheem (The Most Merciful) in elegant black calligraphy.

Hand-painted using high-grade acrylic paints, the plaque features a soft terracotta pink matte backdrop contrasting with the bold black and gold elements of the Kaaba. Brass standoff screws at the four corners lift the plaque off the wall for a modern dimensional effect.

A clear gloss varnish finish coats the plaque, defending the acrylic artwork from dust, humidity, and handling marks while giving the surface a gentle, tactile finish.

Ideally suited for neutral stone niches, limestone plaster walls, display shelving surrounded by natural crystals, brass lanterns, and warm desert-toned decor.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Acrylic paints on an arched composite plaque with brass mounting hardware

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for surface durability and dust defense

Theme & Script: The Holy Kaaba artwork with Ar-Raheem (The Most Merciful) calligraphy

Color Palette: Warm terracotta pink, deep black, and shimmering gold accents

Style: Warm Artisanal / Mediterranean-Inspired Islamic Art

Ideal Placement: Wall niche, shelf display area, entryway accent wall, or living room shelf
